summary.text: John Stroup is the Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Addison-3 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a former officeholder of the Addison Northwest Unified School District, Vergennes.

paragraphs.text: John Stroup advanced from the Democratic primary for the Addison-3 District on August 11, 2026, receiving the most votes in a three-candidate field that included Ariel Bolles and Michael Kane.
